declarations.description:
A menu of commands anchored to a trigger. The trigger is slotted into `trigger` (a `c2-button`, a `c2-icon-button`,
a plain `<button>`, …) or named by `anchor`; the rows are `c2-menu-item` children, with `<hr>` separators and
`<h1>`–`<h6>` group headings between them. The surface is a native popover on the top layer positioned by
`c2-overlay`, so it flips near the viewport edge, light-dismisses on Escape and outside clicks, and is never clipped
by an `overflow: hidden` parent.

Keyboard: the trigger opens the menu with Enter, Space or ArrowDown (ArrowUp opens it on the last row). Inside,
Arrow Up/Down move between enabled rows, Home/End jump to the first/last, typing letters jumps to a matching row,
Enter and Space activate, ArrowRight opens a submenu, ArrowLeft returns to its parent row, and Escape or Tab closes
the menu and returns focus to the trigger.

Activating a row fires `menu-select` and closes the menu; `keep-open` on the menu (or on a single row) leaves it
open, which is what a list of `checkbox` rows wants.

The surface is as wide as its rows, never narrower than `--c2-menu--min-width` and, when the menu owns its trigger,
never narrower than that trigger either. `fit-anchor` pins it to exactly the trigger's width instead.
declarations.name: Menu

cssProperties.description: Floor for the surface, which is otherwise as wide as its content (and never narrower than a slotted trigger).

cssProperties.name: --c2-menu--max-height

members.name: open
members.description: Whether the menu is showing. Set it to open or close the menu from code.

members.name: placement
members.description: Preferred placement of the surface (floating-ui names). Submenus default to `right-start`.

members.name: anchor
members.description: Anchor element, or (attribute) the id of an element in the same tree. Defaults to the slotted trigger.

members.name: fitAnchor
members.description: Make the surface exactly as wide as the anchor instead of as wide as its content.

members.name: keepOpen
members.description: Keep the menu open after a row is activated. Also available per row as `keep-open`.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Ignores the trigger and never opens.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name of the surface.

members.name: hasTrigger
members.description: Whether something is slotted into `trigger`; a menu opened from one is never narrower than it.

members.name: focusedItem
members.description: The row that holds the roving `tabindex`.

members.name: pendingFocus
members.description: Which row to focus once the surface is open.

members.name: openBeforePress
members.description: Open state at the pointerdown that started the current press on the trigger, see `handleTriggerPointerDown`.

members.name: items
members.description: Slotted rows, in DOM order (separators and headings excluded).

members.name: triggerElement
members.description: The element that opens this menu: the slotted trigger, or the resolved `anchor`.

members.name: ownerItem
members.description: The row this menu is a submenu of, when it is slotted into a `c2-menu-item`.

members.name: show
members.description: Opens the menu. Pass `'last'` to start on the last row, `'none'` to leave focus where it is.

members.name: focusFirstItem
members.description: Moves focus to the first enabled row.

members.name: focusLastItem
members.description: Moves focus to the last enabled row.

members.name: syncTriggerAria
members.description:
`aria-haspopup` / `aria-expanded` belong on the element that carries the button role. For a `c2-*` trigger that is
the control inside its shadow root, not the host, which is a plain generic element.

members.name: syncItems
members.description: Assigns the roving `tabindex` and reserves the indicator column when any row is checkable.

members.name: handleTriggerPointerDown
members.description:
The popover light-dismisses itself when the press lands outside it — the trigger included — so by the time the
click arrives the menu is already closed and a naive toggle would reopen it. Remember the state at pointerdown,
which runs before the dismissal, and toggle from that instead.

members.name: handlePointerOver
members.description: Hovering a row highlights it and swaps which submenu is open, the way a desktop menu does.

members.name: shouldReturnFocus
members.description:
Focus goes back to the trigger unless the dismissal handed it to a real control elsewhere — clicking a row leaves
the focus on that row in Chromium and WebKit but on the body in Firefox, and either way the trigger is where the
user was.

members.name: returnFocus
members.description: Focus goes back to the row that owns this submenu, or to the trigger.

events.description: Bubbles from the activated row: `detail.value`, `detail.checked` and `detail.data` of that row.
events.name: menu-select

events.description: Fired after the menu opens or closes; `newState` is `open` or `closed`.

declarations.description:
A row of a `c2-menu`: a command, a link (`href`), a checkbox or a radio (`type`), or the parent of a nested menu
slotted into `submenu`. Activating a row fires `menu-select` and closes the menu unless the row is marked
`keep-open`. The default slot is the label, `description` a second muted line, `prefix-icon` / `suffix-icon` take an
inline SVG, a `c2-feather-*` icon or a `c2-mat-icon`, and `shortcut` holds a keyboard hint (plain text or a `c2-kbd`).

Rows never handle the keyboard themselves: the menu owns arrow keys, typeahead and the roving `tabindex`, and marks
every row `reserve-indicator` while any sibling is checkable so the labels of plain and checkable rows line up.
declarations.name: MenuItem

cssProperties.description: Space between the indicator, icons, label and shortcut.
cssProperties.name: --c2-menu-item--gap

cssProperties.description: Also the highlight of the keyboard-focused row.
cssProperties.name: --c2-menu-item__hover--background

cssProperties.description: The check mark / radio dot. Defaults to the row colour.
cssProperties.name: --c2-menu-item__indicator--color

cssProperties.description: Label and icon colour of a `destructive` row.
cssProperties.name: --c2-menu-item__destructive--color

slots.description: The row label. Falls back to `label`, then `value`, when empty.
slots.name: default

slots.description: Secondary line under the label (muted, smaller).
slots.name: description

slots.description: Icon shown after the label; replaced by the chevron when the row has a submenu.
slots.name: suffix-icon

slots.description: Keyboard hint, aligned to the end of the row.
slots.name: shortcut

slots.description: A nested `c2-menu` opened by hover, click, Enter or ArrowRight.
slots.name: submenu

members.name: value
members.description: The value reported in `menu-select`.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Dims the row and ignores clicks and keyboard.

members.name: type
members.description: `item` is a command, `checkbox` toggles, `radio` picks one row of a `name` group.

members.name: checked
members.description: Checked state of a `checkbox` / `radio` row; shown as a check mark or a dot.

members.name: name
members.description: Radio group name. Selecting a `radio` row unchecks the other rows of the same group in that menu.

members.name: href
members.description: Makes the row a link; Enter and a click navigate, and `menu-select` still fires.

members.name: destructive
members.description: Paints the row in the destructive colour, for delete-style commands.

members.name: keepOpen
members.description: Keeps the menu open after this row is activated, e.g. for a checkbox row.

members.name: label
members.description: Label used for typeahead and as the default slot's fallback content.

members.name: data
members.description: Arbitrary payload returned alongside `value` in `menu-select`. Not an attribute.

members.name: expanded
members.description: Set by the parent menu while this row's submenu is open. Announced as `aria-expanded`.

members.name: reserveIndicator
members.description: Private: set by the parent menu on every row while any sibling is checkable, so the labels line up.

members.name: authorRole
members.description: `role` written by the author, kept over the automatic one.

members.name: hasSubmenu
members.description: Whether a menu is slotted into `submenu`.

members.name: submenuElement
members.description: The element slotted into `submenu`, if any. The parent menu opens and closes it.

members.name: displayText
members.description: The text the menu matches while typing: `label` when set, otherwise the slotted label text.

members.name: activate
members.description:
Activates the row the way Enter does: a link is navigated, a checkable row toggles, and `menu-select` fires.
A row with a submenu does nothing — the menu opens the submenu instead.

events.name: menu-select
events.description: Fired after the row is activated by a click, Enter or Space. Cancelable; a row with a submenu never fires it.

events.name: checked-change
events.description: Fired after the `checked` state of a `checkbox` / `radio` row changes.
